Hello. I'm trying to slightly alter the actionbutton input binding object to fit my needs. There is three buttons (lets say b1,b2 and execute).b1 and b2 represents choices while execute button do some processing after user clicks either b1 or b2. So i set all buttons to actionbutton class and everything works really nice. But if i want to count how many times user has pressed b1 or b2 there is a possible error. Because they are action buttons they do +1 at each click. I would like to set b1 and b2 to another custom input binding class that will behave as following: cutom input binding class is triggered by pressing execute button and checking if b1 is clicked. Then value of b1 can be +1 and not any time you press b1. or let's say we want to add +1 to the last pressed button before execute button is pressed.

Reading tutorials with custom input binding didn't give solution while not being "pro" in JQuery

Super thanks in advance for any thought

This question should be equal to many user questions of how you can add a js variable in shiny and finally in R. I set this question to the forum with the hope of expressing many other people with same problems.And I clearly think that custom inputbinding is the key for shiny's booming.
